before.approach: Drive Mt. Baker Highway (SR 542) to Hannegan Pass Road (FS 32); at 1.3 miles bear left onto Ruth Creek Road and continue to its end at Hannegan Campground (about 2,950 ft). From the pullout/campground, cross Ruth Creek (a log crossing has been used) and bushwhack roughly 45 minutes through slide alder and devil's club to the base of the Wall Street couloir.

road.name: Hannegan Pass Road (FS 32) / Ruth Creek Road
road.status: Gravel Forest Service road to Hannegan Campground/trailhead
road.driveNote: From Mt. Baker Hwy (SR 542) ~12.5 mi east of Glacier, turn onto Hannegan Pass Rd (FS 32); at 1.3 mi bear left onto Ruth Creek Rd and continue ~5.4 mi to road's end at Hannegan Campground.
road.seasonalGate: Snow-closed in winter/spring; check Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie NF alerts for opening date

approach_logistics.trailheadDirection: From the Hannegan Campground pullout at the end of Ruth Creek Road (~2,950 ft), off Hannegan Pass Road (FS 32) from the Mt. Baker Highway

before.itinerary: Single-push day: drive to the Ruth Creek/Hannegan CG trailhead (2,950 ft); cross Ruth Creek and bushwhack to the base of Wall Street (~45 min); climb the snow couloir to the Northwest Glacier (~5,000 ft); cross the glacier to the 6,500-ft saddle; scramble the southeast ridge to the 7,191-ft summit (about 5.6 hours car-to-summit in one reported trip); descend the same line (about 2.8 hours back to the car).
